find: for (const sprite of cl.billows) sprite.material.opacity = cl.peak * fade;
replace: for (const sprite of cl.billows) sprite.material.opacity = SMOKE.fired.peakOpacity * fade;
why: Fades from a shared constant instead of the cloud's own peak. The refusal is still born nearly solid, so anything reading the material at spawn passes; one frame later the soot has been pulled back to the ordinary puff's weight and stays there for the rest of its life. A defect visible for one sixtieth of a second and then permanently is the shape a birth-time assertion cannot catch, which is why the suite also samples mid-life.
killedBy: muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) keeps a refusal DENSE for its whole life, not just at birth
